sentences.text: Traukutitan is known as a large member of the titanosaurid group.
Its middle tail bones feature a flat back surface on the central block, differing from the usual rounded shape.
The name combines a local mountain spirit with Greek giants to honor its massive size.
Remains were uncovered in the lowest layer of the Bajo de la Carpa Formation in North Patagonia, Argentina.
Scientists Rubén Darío Juárez Valieri and Jorge Orlando Calvo officially named the genus in 2011.
Experts place this animal in the family Titanosauridae and suggest it belongs to the clade Lognkosauria.
This creature roamed South America during the late Cretaceous period.
Its time range falls within the Santonian age, spanning from 85.7 to 83.6 million years ago.
